question: Which state gives the annual award Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The annual award named after Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra is given by the state of Odisha.
 
• This award is a recognition of outstanding contributions in the field of art and culture, especially in dance and music.
 
• Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra was a legendary figure in the Indian classical dance form of Odissi.
 
• The award celebrates excellence and dedication towards preserving and promoting India's rich cultural heritage. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
Aspect

 
 
 
Details

 
 
 

 
 
Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra

 
 
 
Renowned as a master of the Odissi dance form, his contributions played a pivotal role in popularizing Odissi dance on the global stage.

 
 
 

 
 
Odissi Dance

 
 
 
One of the eight classical dance forms of India, characterized by its fluid movements and expressive gestures that tell mythological stories.

 
 
 

 
 
Award Significance

 
 
 
Encourages artists to pursue excellence in their field and contributes to the preservation of Indian cultural heritage.

 
 
 

 
 
Cultural Impact

 
 
 
The award not only honors the legacy of Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra but also inspires young artists to follow in his footsteps.
